I've replied to Pree in a #central-team thread. The store is Pine Crossing.

Pree posted it in #central-team herself on Jun 9. The morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support test it with the store login.

I couldn't find an address or any other location for Pine Crossing in the sources Pree has access to, and I told her so. I also pointed out that Pine Crossing isn't one of the six new stores on onboarding ticket SUP-5102 (North Creek, Elm Junction, Prairie Bend, Mill Crossing, West Ridge, South Fork). I suggested she check the name against store ops' list before updating the sheet.

One thing to check: the SUP-5102 ticket came from the knowledge brain's Central team pages, but the shared file listing showed me no account files. So I couldn't confirm from the files that Pree can open the ticket herself. The reply only mentions the ticket number and the six store names, which count as operational facts for her own team's account.
